heading: Questions that cross boundaries
body: My research examines how ecological processes connect aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, with particular emphasis on the movement of energy, nutrients, and contaminants through food webs. I combine field studies, stable isotope analysis, fatty-acid biomarkers, and ecological modeling to investigate the mechanisms that structure ecological communities and how these relationships respond to environmental change.
